summary: The Hetzner Robot storage box API was set to sunset on July 30, 2025, and the hrobot storagebox modules needed adjusting to the new API, which requires a registered API token passed as hetzner_token. Return values might change.
questions: Why will my Hetzner storagebox modules stop working?
What credentials does the new Hetzner storage box API need?
When is the Robot storage box API being shut down?

answer_card.title: Hetzner storage box API sunset
answer_card.answer_md: The Hetzner Robot API for storage boxes sunsets on July 30, 2025. The new API needs a registered API token passed as `hetzner_token`. Module usage and return values may change slightly as the modules are adapted.
